King James Drive Southwest — STREET VIEW — walkable v14

The dark ribbon is King James Drive Southwest at its true width, segmented every 2.5 m with every point's height set from the ground, so it rides on the surface instead of diving through the hill (the red marker stands at the old worst spot). A red car is parked on the street next to the character - walk up to it and press E or the 🚗 Get in button to drive. Driving uses big press-and-hold buttons - ◀ ▶ steer (bottom left) and GAS / BRAKE pedals (bottom right) - or the keys (W/S or ↑/↓ = gas & brake/reverse, A/D or ←/→ = steer). Press E again to get out. While you drive, the view sits on the roof of the car, facing forward, turning and leaning with the car, tilted up so only a sliver of hood shows at the bottom of the screen. New in v14: orbiting is a button. By default a drag pans and two fingers zoom — no gesture swings the camera. Tap the 🔄 Orbit button (top right) and drags orbit instead; tap it again to go back. Also in this build, from v13: (1) Every street now sits exactly 0.01 m over the ground you see. Joshua spotted a slight space under the road in places: the heights had been set from the survey ground, but the drawn ground mesh sags a few centimetres against the survey between its posts, and the ribbons were flat across their width - so edges floated or dug in on slopes (worst about 4 m on the widest road). Now each street is draped: its centre and both edges follow the drawn ground itself at +0.01 m, with extra points wherever the ground bends, so there is no space under the road anywhere in the one-mile circle. (2) Everything from v12 carries over: every street in the radius conformed (all 520 road records; about 7.1 km had been buried) and the houses moved off streets - see the buildings line under this panel. (3) The roof camera panel: tap the 📷 button while driving to move the camera (Forward / Back / Left / Right / Up / Down) and tilt it, then Save camera to keep the whole setup on this device. This is the transform only - not baked; the real map data is untouched. The light-blue road is King James seen through the ground (toggle: X-ray street). Walk with the joystick (bottom left) or keys; drive with the buttons or keys - the readout should say on the surface everywhere. Drag pans, two fingers zoom — orbit only after tapping the 🔄 Orbit button.
